item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 24/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Ma-on will move across the northeastern part of the South China Sea, in the general direction of the coast of western Guangdong today, and intensifying gradually. There will be heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the region on Wednesday and Thursday. The weather will be windy and seas will be high with swells, and will lead to storm surge. The landfall intensity of Ma-on still remain uncertain. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 24/08 (Wednesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 2 to 4, force 5 to 6 at night.
Weather: Very hot with haze. Mainly fine at first apart from isolated showers and thunderstorms. A few squally showers and thunderstorms later. There will be swells.
Temp range: 27 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 25/08 (Thursday)
Wind: Northeast force 5 to 6 at first. Becoming southeast force 7 to 8 in the morning, up to force 11 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy to overcast with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms. Seas will be very rough to high with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
